title: Rumen Ecosystem Enhancer

sections.heading: Rumen Ecosystem Enhancer
sections.text: Inefficient rumen fermentation and poor fiber digestibility are major constraints in dairy production. These issues result in suboptimal nutrient extraction, lower milk yields, and compromised animal health. Rumen Ecosystem Enhancer is a yeast-based supplement combining active dried yeast, bioactives, and fiber-digesting enzymes. This unique blend enhances rumen microflora, stabilizes pH, and improves fiber digestion, leading to superior nutrient assimilation and overall performance. Components Active Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Dried Yeast Bioactive yeast metabolites, Nucleotides, Small-chain Peptides, Polysaccharides Herbal Digestives Fiber-Digesting Enzymes: Cellulase, Xylanase, Amylase, β-Glucanase

sections.heading: Components
sections.text: Active Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Dried Yeast Bioactive yeast metabolites, Nucleotides, Small-chain Peptides, Polysaccharides Herbal Digestives Fiber-Digesting Enzymes: Cellulase, Xylanase, Amylase, β-Glucanase Key Features Dried yeast provides high-quality nutrients to the rumen microflora. Active dried yeast improves nutrient digestibility and positively impacts the composition of volatile fatty acids (VFA) in the rumen. Fiber-digesting enzymes along with other bioactives help to improve the cellulolytic bacterial population in the rumen.

sections.heading: Key Features
sections.text: Dried yeast provides high-quality nutrients to the rumen microflora. Active dried yeast improves nutrient digestibility and positively impacts the composition of volatile fatty acids (VFA) in the rumen. Fiber-digesting enzymes along with other bioactives help to improve the cellulolytic bacterial population in the rumen. Benefits Improvement in dry matter intake, thus positively impacting milk yield. Enhances nutrient digestibility through effective improvement in fiber digestion. Helps maintain the right pH of the rumen, reducing the chances of SARA (Subacute Rumen Acidosis).

sections.heading: Benefits
sections.text: Improvement in dry matter intake, thus positively impacting milk yield. Enhances nutrient digestibility through effective improvement in fiber digestion. Helps maintain the right pH of the rumen, reducing the chances of SARA (Subacute Rumen Acidosis). Usage & Presentation General recommendations: 2.5g-5g: Young post-wean calves and growing heifers. 10g-20g: Lactating animals. 20g: Far-off animals in the transition period. Specific Inclusion: As directed by an Animal Nutritionist or a registered Veterinary Practitioner. Presentation: 25kg bag.
